verdict.text: The change does what the plan asks.
Both `platform_toolsets` lists in `deployments/applications/services/hermes.hcl` now name `file`, every entry is a toolset upstream defines, and the new test fails on the old config.
The seven SKILL.md edits fix the same wrong name and belong in this ticket.
Nothing blocks.

Gates, re-run from the worktree with `loopctl gate stamp`: "pass gate pre_commit", "pass gate cli_tests", "pass eval-row r1", "stamp green: b76b4b5db7642ffc200e9a2385176d98175f8f7c43c9c948a4023935e3176ddf".
Diff: the changes are uncommitted in the worktree (`git diff HEAD`), and HEAD equals main.
Nine files: hermes.hcl (two lines), the test file, and seven SKILL.md lines.
Correctness: read the rendered `platform_toolsets` block (hermes.hcl around line 330).
Both lists are terminal, web, browser, memory, skills, file, cronjob.
The plan-reviewer's r1 verdict checked each of these against upstream `toolsets.py` at v0.22.2 and v0.23.4.
The test's allowlist is a subset of upstream names, which can only make the test stricter.
Row r1: the test's `fails_when` is "any entry not in the list, or `file` missing from either list".
I ran the test's regex and assertions in a scratch script against changed copies of the file.
Original passes.
`files` in telegram only fails, `files` in both fails, and removing `file` from email fails.
The test also asserts that exactly email and telegram are parsed, so a regex that silently matches nothing cannot pass.
The check holds what the row asks.
Row r2 (judgment): this is a deploy-time check (gateway log with no "references unknown toolset", and a Telegram file read).
It cannot be judged before the apply.
It is not judged here and needs its evidence recorded after the deploy.
Scope of the SKILL.md edits: `services.tf:296-298` folds every SKILL.md into the hermes job, so the agent reads these lines at runtime.
"via the `files` toolset" points the agent at a name that does not exist.
That is the same defect as P1, and the fix reaches G1 ("the toolsets the config means them to have").
The job gets re-registered by the hcl change anyway, so the skill edits add no extra apply.
In scope.
Consistency: grepped the repo (excluding `.loop/` and `.git`) for "files toolset" and `- files`.
Nothing is left except the guard test's own string.
No docs/ or .okf/ page names the toolset.
The comment above `KNOWN_TOOLSETS` gives a reason the code cannot state (the upstream source and the silent-skip behavior), so it meets minimal-comments.
None.
The plan's `touches` leaves out the seven SKILL.md files.
That is fine for this ticket.
A future plan could name them so the touched paths match.
`KNOWN_TOOLSETS` cites v0.22.2.
When `hermes-update-0-23` lands, update the comment's version if the set is re-checked.
